title: Is scl rational for chains in the closed genus 2 surface group?
body:
## The question

Let S be the closed orientable surface of genus 2, and let C be a chain in pi_1(S): a
formal sum of cyclically reduced conjugacy classes whose total homology class is trivial.

Is scl(C) always rational?

This is the simplest closed hyperbolic surface, and so the natural first case in which to
settle the general conjecture.

It is an important test case rather than a subgoal, and the distinction is worth keeping.
No theorem is known that would make a solution here imply the general statement for all
closed hyperbolic surfaces; the expectation is only that a solution would bear on it,
probably by exposing what the general argument would have to control.
